1185351800796389376.a: First grade was, often no adults present, in a class of 40-50 kids. Teacher took roll call, gave us coloring books, went to lounge to smoke, came back to take us to lunch some days, etc. We all were forced to be examined by shady doctors. Some molested. Food full of roaches. Guns

1185351805179445248.a: My point is that most of the black kids didn't have the luxury of testing out at all. And even if they did often their parents held them back to keep them away from the white kids. I know too many kids from 1st grade who ended up shot dead because they weren't even given a chance

1185352751842299904.a: This was a decade after desegregation. We lived in the same neighborhood but were being forcibly bussed to old "black" and "white" schools across town. So it's not like we were separated due to distance. We hung out at the school a block from our houses! That none of us went to.
